# Keller Lake Animal Hospital

> > AAHA-accredited veterinary hospital in Maplewood, MN providing comprehensive pet care from preventative wellness to advanced surgery and emergency services.

Keller Lake Animal Hospital is an established veterinary clinic in Maplewood, Minnesota, led by Dr. John Lillie Jr. and Dr. Melissa DeWoskin. The hospital offers a full range of veterinary services including preventative care, dental procedures, surgical interventions, laser therapy, and emergency support, with strong partnerships to regional emergency care facilities.

## Core Services

- [Pet Wellness Clinic](https://kellerlake.com/service/pet-wellness-clinic): Preventative wellness exams, vaccinations, and parasite prevention for pets
- [Pet Dental Care](https://kellerlake.com/service/pet-dental-care): Dental cleaning, exams, and extraction services for pet oral health and wellness
- [Veterinary Surgery](https://kellerlake.com/service/veterinary-surgery): Advanced surgical services including spay, neuter, and anesthesia care for pets
- [Sick Pet Care](https://kellerlake.com/sick-pet-care): Sick pet treatment for rashes, infections, ear issues, and other common conditions
- [Laser Pet Therapy](https://kellerlake.com/service/laser-pet-therapy): Laser therapy for pain management and rehabilitation of chronic pet conditions
- [Pet Diagnostics and Laboratory Service](https://kellerlake.com/service/pet-diagnostics): In-house laboratory and diagnostic testing services for comprehensive pet health evaluation
- [Veterinary X-Ray](https://kellerlake.com/service/veterinary-x-ray): X-ray and diagnostic imaging services for accurate pet health diagnostics
- [Pet Microchipping](https://kellerlake.com/service/pet-microchipping): Pet microchipping service for identification and lost pet recovery
- [Services Archive](https://kellerlake.com/service): Archive listing all veterinary services including wellness, dentistry, surgery, and laser therapy
